mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (measured by the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates and reduces equity risk premiums, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 3-month change in FEDFUNDS is negative but 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index value above 305.0 signals persistent inflation, triggering central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 305.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500.0 and residential sales (RSAFS) fall below 700000.0, it signals a demand shock that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1500.0 and RSAFS < 700000.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In labor market tightening regimes (UNRATE < 3.5 and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% over the past month), the economy faces inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5 and PAYEMS > 157000.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (measured by the 3-month change in INDPRO) signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 3-month change in INDPRO is negative but 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) value below 1500.0 signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1500.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.0 (INDPRO) signals an economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
